_readme: sync.sh reads both, merging base * local so local wins per field — an override
can restate one key without repeating the whole server. Either file may be absent.
url and headers are expanded from the environment at render time, because only
claude and opencode interpolate env vars in those fields. Keep ${VAR} references
here rather than literals so the file stays host-agnostic; an unset var aborts
the sync by name. Vars live in dotfiles/zsh/.config/zsh/.zshenv.local.
bearer_token_env is an env var NAME, never the token. sync.sh never reads it — it
renders the name in each framework's own syntax (${VAR}, {env:VAR},
bearer_token_env_var). Both url and bearer_token_env are required per server.
headers is optional, for non-secret per-server headers. Its values are expanded
and written as literals, so put nothing secret here. Anything secret belongs in
Keys under _ are ignored. Run `just sync-mcp` after editing.
